sentences.text: Simon Phillip Cowell -LRB- -LSB- ˈkaʊəl -RSB- -RRB- -LRB- born 7 October 1959 -RRB- is an English reality television judge and producer , entrepreneur , and philanthropist .	philanthropist	philanthropy

He is most recognised as a judge on the British TV talent competition series Pop Idol , The X Factor , and Britain 's Got Talent , and the American TV talent competition shows American Idol , The X Factor , and America 's Got Talent .	Pop Idol	Pop Idol	American Idol	American Idol	Idol	Idol series	The X Factor	The X Factor (U.K.)	Got Talent	Got Talent
Cowell is the principal founder and chief executive of the British entertainment company Syco .	Syco	Syco
As a judge , Cowell often makes blunt and controversial comments , including insults and wisecracks about contestants and their singing abilities .
He combines activities in both the television and music industries .
Cowell has produced and promoted singles and albums for various singers that he has taken under his wing .

He is currently appearing on the eleventh Series of Britain 's Got Talent and , recently , the thirteenth series of UK 's The X Factor along with the eleventh series of America 's Got Talent .	The X Factor	The X Factor (U.K.)	Got Talent	Got Talent	eleventh Series	Britain's Got Talent (series 11)	thirteenth series	The X Factor (UK series 13)	eleventh series	America's Got Talent (season 11)
In 2004 and 2010 , Time named Cowell one of the 100 most influential people in the world .	Time	Time magazine

In 2008 The Daily Telegraph ranked him sixth in their list of the `` 100 most powerful people in British culture '' .	The Daily Telegraph	The Daily Telegraph	British culture	Culture of the United Kingdom
